name: 书籍翻译与注音
author: Libzora
description: 整本书翻译和注音。翻译使用应用中配置的模型服务（支持本机模型），注音使用内置或 g2pW 引擎，结果直接加入书库。翻译书籍和注音书籍仅供本人学习使用，传播或公开使用产生的责任由用户承担。

en-US.name: Book Translation & Pinyin
en-US.description: Translate whole books or add pinyin. Translation uses the configured model service, including local models; pinyin uses the built-in or g2pW engine. Results are added to the library. Translated and pinyin-annotated books are for personal study only; users are responsible for any distribution or public use.
